$comment: The consolidated-design half of Phase E's MCP tool-selection benchmark question set (docs/improvement-plan-provenance-diff.md). This file is a portable export of okf_mcp::tool_selection_benchmark::questions() -- a non-Rust live-endpoint runner can load this directly instead of re-deriving the question set. Kept in sync with the Rust source by a dedicated consistency test (crates/okf-mcp/src/tool_selection_benchmark.rs); do not hand-edit one without the other.
schema_note: Each question is answered by calling the consolidated `graph` tool with the given arguments (relation plus whichever of id/from/to that relation needs). expected_substring is the known-correct answer, verified in Rust against a real fixture bundle -- see fixture_bundle() in the same module.

questions.prompt: What's the shortest call path from foo to bar?

questions.note: explain shipped after the graph_* consolidation this benchmark reconstructs, so it has no historical specialized-tool counterpart -- scored against the consolidated design only.

questions.prompt: Is foo part of the public API?
Does the call graph have any cycles?
Which concepts have no calls in or out?
What are this bundle's concept-kind and relationship stats?
What layer is each package in?
Which packages form a connected domain?
What design patterns are detected in this bundle?
What REST endpoints, database models, or event-flow participants exist?
